notes: Probe results: robots.txt 200, permissive (Yoast WP site) but Disallows /feed/ and /*/feed/ and site search, so RSS and search are closed; it advertises sitemap_index.xml and sitemap-news.xml. sitemap_index.xml 200 -> numbered post-sitemapN.xml (Yoast), avoided because lastmod there is edit time. Chosen route: WP REST API GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&page=N&after=2026-09-24T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T00:00:00&_fields=date_gmt,link, all 200, 10 pages total, ~40s including 1s sleeps. Date choice: article pages carry their date ONLY in JSON-LD datePublished / meta article:published_time, both UTC +00:00, no human-readable visible date. Verified via ?slug= lookup that REST 'date' is site-local (Peru UTC-5, e.g. 2026-09-30T19:37:14) while 'date_gmt' equals the page JSON-LD exactly (2026-10-01T00:37:14+00:00) — so the script lists the date_gmt date part, which matches the stated page date exactly (diff 0 days on all 5 spot-checked samples) instead of risking the 1-day off that the local date would cause for articles published 00:00-04:59 local. Window filter applied on the UTC date. Result: 887 unique URLs, 31/31 days covered, per-day 9-45, probe days 09-30=33, 10-10=26, 10-20=32 (min day 2026-10-25=9, not a probe day). 5 sample article re-fetches: all 200, page datePublished diff 0 days, text 7954-10003 chars (well over 1500). No 403/429/WAF encountered at 1 req/s.
